newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PNCC says to bid for mass rail system.
newsitem.headline: PNCC says to bid for mass rail system.

text.p: Philippine National Construction Corp (PNCC) said on Tuesday it had entered into a joint venture with Kumagai Gumi Co Ltd of Japan and Bechtel Overseas Corp of the United States to bid for the construction of a mass rail transit project in Manila.

In a letter to the Philippine Stock Exchange, PNCC said the consortium would submit its bid for the construction of the super structure and stations of the Manila Strategic Mass Rail Transit Development (Line 2) project.
PNCC also said it had contracted local firm Micrologic Systems Inc to supply, install and implement the computerised toll collection system in its two toll roads.
"The magnetic card collection system aims to improve the integrity of PNCC's collection system," president Rogelio Luis said in the letter.
